content.text: Digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable face a significant challenge in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-webhooks-cloudflare-workers-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-cloudflare-workers-crypto-24|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-18|setting]] up an effective online store. Countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Ethiopia often struggle with infrastructure limitations that hinder commerce. COREMERCH offers two distinct stacks for digital store deployment, Stack 01 and Stack 02, each tailored to different needs. Understanding the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-selling-digital-products-africa-3|The Real]]s between these stacks is crucial for creators looking to establish a sovereign digital store that accepts crypto payments without relying on restrictive platforms.
What Each Option Actually Offers

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, enabling swift deployment within 4-6 hours as outlined in the Sovereign Blueprint. This stack is ideal for those who need a straightforward solution for limited product offerings. In contrast, Stack 02 incorporates Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, providing a more robust infrastructure capable of supporting up to five products. Deployed in 48 hours, this stack includes end-to-end testing, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, ensuring that creators have a secure and efficient platform for their digital goods.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Both stacks are designed with the unique challenges faced by creators in restricted countries in mind. Stack 01 is a quick solution for those who need immediate access to a basic online store, but lacks advanced features that could enhance user experience. Stack 02, with its Cloudflare-based architecture, offers better performance and scalability, making it more suitable for creators who anticipate growth and require a more dependable infrastructure. This capability is essential for creators in countries facing economic instability and payment restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, both stacks leverage NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. Stack 01 incurs minimal fees but may not handle high transaction volumes as efficiently due to its simpler architecture. In contrast, Stack 02 benefits from the robust infrastructure provided by Cloudflare Workers, allowing for faster payment processing and better handling of multiple transactions. This efficiency can lead to lower overall costs for creators as they scale their operations and manage higher sales volumes.
Choose Stack 02 for a scalable digital store that grows with your business.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant advantages of both stacks is the complete ownership creators retain over their digital store. With COREMERCH, there are no ongoing subscription fees or platform dependencies. After deployment, creators have total control of their infrastructure. Stack 02 enhances this ownership by automating various functions through Supabase, which can streamline order management and product delivery. This automation is critical for creators aiming for a hands-off approach while maintaining a professional storefront.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing between Stack 01 and Stack 02 primarily hinges on your immediate needs and future growth plans. If you require a quick setup for a few digital products, Stack 01 is a suitable choice, allowing you to get up and running rapidly. Conversely, if you anticipate needing more advanced capabilities and a scalable solution, Stack 02 is worth the investment. Its comprehensive features and infrastructure robustness make it an ideal option for serious creators looking to establish a sustainable online presence.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Ownership of your infrastructure means complete freedom from platform lock-in.

Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Start by selecting the appropriate stack based on your needs. Follow the Sovereign Blueprint for Stack 01 deployment, which takes 4-6 hours. For Stack 02, expect a deployment time of 48 hours. Configure your domain and set up your payment layer with NOWPayments. Load your products and configure delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, conduct thorough testing before promoting your store.
